description_en: Queries the details about fields in a table
name: ListTableColumns

parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The ID of a physical database: You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation to obtain the physical database ID
parameters.help_zh: 物理库ID：可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html获取该参数的值

parameters.help_zh:
表名。

parameters.name: table_name

parameters.help_en: The schema name of the table, which is required only for SQL Server instances
parameters.help_zh: 表模式名，仅当SQLServer需要传递为架构名
parameters.name: table_schema_name

Column.description_en: The details about fields in the table

AutoIncrement.description_en:
Indicates whether the field is an auto-increment field. Valid values:

true: The field is an auto-increment field.
false: The field is not an auto-increment field
AutoIncrement.description_zh:
当前字段是否自增。返回值如下：
true：自增。
false：不自增

ColumnType.description_en: The data type of the field

DataPrecision.description_en: The number of valid digits for the column

DataScale.description_en: The number of decimal places of the field data

DefaultValue.description_en: The default value of the column

FunctionType.description_en:
The type of the masking algorithm that is used for the field. Valid values:

null: No masking algorithm is used.
DEFAULT: A full masking algorithm is used.
FIX_POS: The fixed position is masked.
FIX_CHAR: The fixed characters are replaced
FunctionType.description_zh:
字段遮掩算法类型，返回值如下：
null：无遮掩
DEFAULT：全遮掩
FIX_POS：固定位置遮掩
FIX_CHAR：固定字符替换

Nullable.description_en:
Indicates whether the field can be empty. Valid values:

true: The field can be empty.
false: The field cannot be empty
Nullable.description_zh:
字段是否可空，返回值如下：
true：可空
false：不可空

SecurityLevel.description_en:
The security level of the field. Valid values:

INNER: The field is an internal field but not sensitive.
SENSITIVE: The field is sensitive.
CONFIDENTIAL: The field is a confidential column
SecurityLevel.description_zh:
安全级别，返回值如下：
INNER：内部（非敏感）
SENSITIVE：敏感
CONFIDENTIAL：机密

Sensitive.description_en:
Indicates whether the field is a sensitive column. Valid values:

true: The field is a sensitive field.
false: The field is not a sensitive field
Sensitive.description_zh:
是否敏感字段，返回值如下：
true：敏感字段
false：非敏感字段

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request failed
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误码，请求异常时返回

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message that is returned if the request failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
